config._comment: Every tunable in one place, written for 1h bars (other intervals are rescaled automatically). These defaults are the configuration that held up best in docs/RESEARCH.md: fixed-ratio hedge, strict cointegration, wide stop sized from risk, OI/impulse/carry filters. costs.takerFee/slippage are blended for hybrid (maker-then-hedge) entries; see docs/STRATEGY.md.
